title: Hotel Nacional de Cuba

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately outside the mapped landward entrance projection. Individual thresholds and terrace grades are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap building way 23866797 fixes the principal hotel footprint within named hotel site 1497720993. Separate ways map the twin roof towers and eight smaller corner turrets. The lower entrance and attached northwestern wing share boundaries with the main hotel.
mapIdentity.scope: Hotel way 23866797, connected entrance and northwest wing, and mapped tower and turret parts establish the modeled exterior. The H-plan has two deep open forecourts and lower attached ranges.

note: The 2007 approach and 2006 oblique show the cream façades, stacked window rows, paired tower crowns and smaller corner turrets. Rear walls, decorative details and exact heights are approximate. The 160-meter terrain field covers the entire connected hotel and forecourt.
